column1: # poseidon.tsv: nova-snark 0.76.0 provider/poseidon.rs PoseidonRO<F> scripted sessions with PoseidonConstantsCircuit::default().
# Field name = the field the RO is over (its elements are Base elements of the engine): fp (= Pallas base = Vesta scalar) or fq. Elements 64 hex (32 B LE).
# CompressedSNARK uses ROMode::Wide (the default, ROTrait::new). Narrow is only provided as a reference for the type.
# output = nova's squeeze(num_bits, start_with_one): the first num_bits LITTLE-endian bits of raw's canonical integer, as a field element, then bit num_bits-1 forced to 1 if start_with_one.
# raw = the full Poseidon output before truncation. After a squeeze the RO state becomes the single element [raw] (NOT the truncated output).

# Hash definition (verified here by an independent plain implementation, see poseidon_params.tsv): SAFE sponge, width t = arity+1 (wide arity 24 -> t = 25, rate 24; narrow arity 5 -> t = 6, rate 5), state[0] = capacity tag, state[1..t] = rate.

# tag = x*(n + 2^31) + x^2   (mod 2^128, as a little-endian u128 -> field element) for n >= 1 absorbed elements, with x = (2^128 - 159); for n = 0 tag = x.  (This is IOPattern[Absorb(n), Squeeze(1)].value(0).)
# absorb: for each element, if the absorb position == rate then permute and reset the position to 0; state[1 + pos] += element; pos += 1.   squeeze: permute once, raw = state[1].

# permutation: for round r in 0..rf+rp: state[i] += rc[r*t + i] for all i; S-box x^5 on all t elements if r < rf/2 or r >= rf/2 + rp else only on state[0]; state = M * state (M symmetric, so M*state == state*M).
